control.citation: Cooksey, Allen and Tsai, Journal of Research of NIST 122 (2017), Reference Data Set of Human Skin Reflectance, DOI 10.6028/jres.122.026 and data DOI 10.18434/M38597; subject 15 is the spectrum closest in spectral angle to the 100-subject mean over 450-650 nm.
control.redistribution: Only the 21 values needed at 10 nm spacing are transcribed here; the SHA-pinned public source is fetched for full-spectrum Lab and Q-band localization.

tolerance.kind: RMS of inter-subject population SD at the 21 control wavelengths
tolerance.source: Cooksey et al. 2015 defines population variability as the SD of the full scan set; recomputed from the 100 published subject-average spectra in Cooksey et al. 2017.

control.qBandReference: Prahl OMLC oxyhaemoglobin table, SHA-pinned in the derivation; expected Q bands 542 nm and 577 nm.

Lab.method: Both spectra use the existing D65 / CIE 1931 2-degree path over 380-780 nm; the control Lab is computed from the fetched full NIST subject spectrum.
